title: Dressing Up Panda
paragraphs: “If Sadina-san is around, Larsa-san will get drunk after a drinking contest and slip away, so we need to bring it up properly.”
“Oh my? Now that you mention it, Sasa-chan wasn’t very sociable yesterday. I’ll do my best today to make sure she doesn’t escape!”
Sadina’s sister seemed to be being considerate.
Is that why Filo-tan trusted her?
“In other words, you want to talk to Sasa-chan, right? Even I can tell that much.”

She said that while drinking. Even back in the village, I had thought this, but Sadina’s sister carries a unique atmosphere. She always seems drunk, but she supports everyone as effectively as Father. She’s probably an amazing person.
“Well, I think it’ll be fine, but… Sadina-san, aren’t you going home?”
“I’m fine~.”
“Somehow, before I knew it, she’s mixed in and helping out…”
Father scratched his head and looked at Sadina’s sister.
Isn’t that fine?
“Naofumi-chan, it’s getting late, so the sea might not be that interesting, but why don’t we invite Sasa-chan and the others to go hunting at the sea tomorrow?”
“Hunting, huh…? Larsa-san seems like the type who would enjoy that, so that might be a good idea.”
“Alright, it’s decided. We’ll invite Sasa-chan for tomorrow’s hunt.”

“And at the same time, make sure Larsa-san doesn’t slip away… Since she’s a mercenary, flashing some money might work. But if we’re too pushy, it might make her wary, so it might be better to wait a bit and approach casually… It might be best not to let them know it’s a hero asking.”
Father was mumbling to himself, pondering how to recruit the panda. After a while, once the plan was set, Sadina’s sister spoke.
“Well then, we’re off.”
“We’re going now, Motoyasu-kun, Yuki-chan.”
“Take care.”
“I’ll join you later. The same tavern as yesterday, correct?”
“Probably. If we move, I’ll leave a message with the tavern master.”
“Understood.”

Father and the others waved to us and went off to recruit the panda. After that, once Yuki-chan went to sleep, I went out to pick up Father and the others. Father was cautious, but it seemed that they were indeed at the tavern as planned. In the distance, I saw Sakura-chan dozing off and looking sleepy.
“Sasa-chan is so cute!”
“Yeah, yeah! If we add more ribbons and dress her up, she’ll look even cuter, don’t you think? Her demi-human form was also really beautiful.”

Father was tying ribbons and dressing up the panda, who was being restrained from behind by Sadina’s sister. On top of that, they had dressed her in something that looked like a dress. The panda was trying to resist, but thanks to Sadina’s sister, she was unable to.
Where did they even buy that dress with the large ribbon…? Ah, did the mole adjust the size? Or did they use Sadina’s sister’s wide connections? The memory of me tailoring the last one resurfaced.
“Will you all stop playing around with me!? Ugh, I feel like there’s another snake woman around now!”
“Boss! It looks great on you!”
“Shut up!”
The panda was glaring at the beastmen under her command.

Were her subordinates always like that? Come to think of it, after they learned how to dress up, I recall the beastmen voicing their objections to Father. Or rather, it looks like Sadina’s sister and Father are just having fun with this.
“Sasa-chan becoming more charming makes me happy.”
“That’s because you’re playing around!”
“Sadina-san is, you know…”
“Using a fake name and then doing this… Give me a break! You’re just as bad as them!”
“You’re the one who was complaining about Sakura-chan and the others.”
Sakura-chan, by the way, seems to be already dozing off.
“Nano! Gaelion’s cute form is too adorable to look away from, nano!”

My rival was twirling around in a frilly apron dress, as if trying to appeal to Father. The assistant, seeing the rival like that, looked slightly exasperated. Incidentally, he was also wearing a similar dress.
Where did they change? The mole had a frilled hood placed over her head. It looked a bit extravagant. The ribbons served as accents… This was a complete strategy to capture the panda.
“Father, I’ve come to pick you up.”
“Ah, Motoyasu-kun.”
“Perfect timing! Take these guys home!”
The panda, as if seizing the opportunity, approached me and pleaded.
This is that, isn’t it?
“Do you want me to sew an outfit based on a maid costume?”
“What the hell are you talking about?!”
The panda was yelling something at me.
Did I say something strange? Considering what happened last time, I thought making the outfit that Father had her wear was the best thing I could do.
“Ugh! Is there no one here who’s on my side!?”
The panda, looking as if she was deeply troubled, clutched her head and crouched down.

What’s wrong? Aren’t you the cute-thing lover who was jealous of Keel’s outfit? With ribbons wrapped around her head and body, she looked like something that would be a bigger hit than any panda at a zoo.
“Put on makeup? I think she looks fine as she is now.”
“Sasa-chan has a good base, so let’s just apply it lightly.”
“Stop it!”
The panda spoke in a menacing tone.
“Oh, I see. Got it. You don’t want that, right, Larsa?”
When Father responded honestly, the panda looked stunned, stretching out her hand as if to grasp something in the air.
“Eh… no, I mean, as long as I don’t end up looking gaudy…”
“Then should I put some makeup on Sasa-chan?”
“Hey! Don’t come near me!”
The panda resisted Sadina’s sister. But she seemed fine with Father.
“Rather than makeup, maybe it’s better to start by grooming your fur? And making it as soft as possible… It sounds fun to make Larsa look cuter.”
“Don’t you want to be prettier, Naofumi-chan?”
“Larsa, which do you prefer?”
“Uh… well… I…”
As she spoke, her gaze drifted toward Sakura-chan, my rival, and the mole. As expected, she seems to like cute outfits. Such a dishonest panda.
“See? Larsa actually prefers the cute look, Sadina-san.”
“Oh my, is that so? Then I’ll introduce you to some good shops.”
“…Do whatever you want already.”
The panda gave up and slumped down.
“We want to see more of the boss’s fashion show!”
“Fufu, I have multiple recording crystals here.”
Father began flashing the recording crystals in front of the panda’s subordinates.
Did he prepare those in advance? Everything had been meticulously planned.
“All the outfits she’s worn so far are recorded here. You all… know what this means, right? Auction time!”
“Ten silver coins!”
“Fifteen silver coins!”
“What the hell are you guys doing?!”
The exhausted panda burst into the scene, destroying both the circle and the recording crystal Father was holding.
“Oops, that was a dummy.”
Father pulled out another recording crystal from his pocket.
“W-What’s your goal?! What are you trying to do with me?!”
The panda screamed.
“You’re going to enter Sasa-chan in the Zeltoble Beauty Contest, right?”
“Stop it!”
The panda cried out. Sensing her distress, Father shook his head.
“No, no. I was just messing around. Anyway, tomorrow’s going to be an early day, so we should head back. Larsa, make sure you’re ready too.”
Oh? Did they finish talking before I arrived? As expected of Father. With Sadina’s sister around, it’s like adding a powerful weapon to his arsenal.
